shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，用成套条数加收纳袋建立价值感
一眼看懂一套多档，让人挑档而不是比价
把档位套到真实训练动作上，让买家自我代入
证明一套覆盖上下肢多动作，拉长使用频次
用材质与切口细节替代任何参数主张来证明品质
保留左右双栏与图标行结构，让买家自行得出结论
以齐套与收纳的可见事实降风险并收口全组

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF fields for packshots, cool light grey #E8EBEF for the tier ladder and proof close, lake-blue #1F6FB2 and grey #B9BDC2 panels only inside the two-column comparison, real outdoor training surfaces for scene shots
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in one accent color, shown as blank glyph slots on the layout rails
style.lightingSystem: soft even key with a declared direction, high-key frontal light on white fields, clear neutral daylight around 5500K on scene shots, skimming sweep light for texture, short true contact shadows that ground every loop, no harsh falloff
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium fitness-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, cool light grey #E8EBEF, one lake-blue accent panel #1F6FB2 and deep charcoal #2D2D2D; neutral tone across studio and daylight shots; modern geometric sans-serif kept out of frame on main images; consistent thin-line single-color icon style shown as blank slots; backgrounds alternate between seamless white, cool light grey and real training surfaces, never random textures; soft even key light with a declared direction and true contact shadows that ground every loop; matte band surface rendering with controlled highlights; stable set scale and centered placement with generous clean margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no on-image brand wording.
noDrift: no tier numbers, poundage or tension values rendered anywhere
style.presentationRules: loops always shown as an ordered graduated set at identical scale, slight 3/4 or overhead packshot angles kept stable, band always unobstructed and tension readable in scenes
style.surfaceSystem: matte studio board #FFFFFF and #E8EBEF, blue hard sports court surface, weathered paving stone and a low masonry wall
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif held out of frame on main images; every label row stays an empty bar with no legible characters
